description: Representative raw source metadata/abstract samples used before SciEvo-Lineage structuring. PDFs are not redistributed here; public identifiers and open links are provided for traceability.
source_policy: Public metadata and abstracts were collected through Semantic Scholar, arXiv, DOI/open-access links, and openAccessPdf when available. Only derived structured records are released in release/data/.

records.title: Deep Learning Methods for Small Molecule Drug Discovery: A Survey
records.abstract_excerpt: A comprehensive review of deep learning applications in small molecule drug discovery, including molecule generation, property prediction, retrosynthesis prediction, reaction prediction, datasets, evaluation metrics, remaining challenges, and future trends.

records.title: Learning phase transitions by confusion
records.abstract_excerpt: A neural-network approach identifies phase transitions by training with deliberately incorrect labels, demonstrated on the Kitaev chain, the classical Ising model, and a many-body-localization transition.

records.title: Machine Learning for Multi-Target Drug Discovery: Challenges and Opportunities in Systems Pharmacology
records.abstract_excerpt: A review of machine learning for multi-target drug discovery, covering multi-target prediction, graph-based and multi-task models, oncology, central nervous system disorders, drug repurposing, interpretability, and regulatory issues.

records.title: Review on design strategies and applications of metal-organic framework-cellulose composites
records.abstract_excerpt: A review of MOF/cellulose composite fabrication routes, three-dimensional bio-based cellulosic scaffolds, adsorption, antibacterial uses, protein immobilization, chemical sensors, energy storage, and future directions.

records.title: Magic3D: High-Resolution Text-to-3D Content Creation
records.abstract_excerpt: A two-stage text-to-3D optimization framework first obtains a coarse model with a low-resolution diffusion prior and sparse 3D hash grid, then optimizes a textured 3D mesh with a high-resolution latent diffusion model.

records.title: Molecular Simulation for Atmospheric Reactions: Non-Equilibrium Dynamics, Roaming, and Glycolaldehyde Formation following Photoinduced Decomposition of syn-Acetaldehyde Oxide
records.abstract_excerpt: Molecular dynamics simulations with a neural-network-based potential energy surface characterize decomposition dynamics, OH elimination, roaming, and glycolaldehyde formation in atmospheric reactions.

records.title: Light attention predicts protein location from the language of life
records.abstract_excerpt: Protein language model embeddings and a lightweight attention architecture are used for protein subcellular localization prediction without multiple sequence alignments.

records.title: Context-dependent design of induced-fit enzymes using deep learning generates well-expressed, thermally stable and active enzymes
records.abstract_excerpt: CoSaNN uses deep learning for conformation sampling and sequence optimization in enzyme design, with SolvIT as an expression/solubility optimization layer.

records.title: Machine-learning-accelerated discovery of single-atom catalysts based on bidirectional activation mechanism
records.abstract_excerpt: Density functional theory and machine learning are combined to analyze 126 single-atom catalysts, define a bidirectional activation mechanism, and predict catalytic performance for nitrogen reduction.

records.title: Machine Learning Big Data Set Analysis Reveals C-C Electro-Coupling Mechanism
records.abstract_excerpt: A 2D-3D ensemble machine learning strategy expands quantum chemical calculation data to analyze C-C coupling mechanisms and screen catalyst compositions for CO2 reduction.
